cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Could You Just…
cards.instruction: Turn a difficult task into tiny favors until the help quietly becomes most of the task.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Could you hold this shelf bracket against the holes? It keeps slipping. Please.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Could you turn that top screw once? Then you can let go.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: It's holding. The other screws are already lined up.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Just tighten those, then? And slide the shelf onto it to check. I'll get your coat.

mechanism: A confidently owns a difficult job while adapting requests to B limits, subdividing help until B performs nearly all of it and A retains a small supporting role.
confusable: Distinguish ordinary shared work from successive tiny requests that accumulate most of the task onto B; S02 must keep B willing through concessions.
comparison: Shelf fixing borrows a work-bound person in quick steps; bouquet finishing borrows B practical expertise and progressively transfers craft work.
seedUse: Canonical bracket and bouquet seeds already have clear accumulation; use S02 competent ownership and yielding method instead of generic voluntary/charge prefixes.
